payload.posture: Read Exodus 16:1–8 as one movement in the temptation of Jesus, keeping the passage's actions, setting, sequence, and limits visible.
payload.tension: The passage states israel complains about hunger after leaving Egypt. Moses says the LORD will give bread and test whether the people will walk in his instruction. It does not by itself supply every cause or later interpretation of this part of the temptation of Jesus.
